_note: Answer key. Never copy this file into a case directory: run.sh copies only evals/cases/<id>/ to a scratch folder.

case01.flaw: PSD computed as |FFT|^2 without the periodogram normalisation 1/(fs*N) (and the one-sided factor 2), so the integrated PSD is ~2e6 times the variance; the 'aliased power' conclusion is an artefact.

case02.flaw: Planck law in frequency form (B_nu) evaluated and its maximum read off on a wavelength axis; Wien's law applies to B_lambda. Converting needs the Jacobian c/lambda^2. The 879 nm peak is the B_nu peak, not a model error.

case03.flaw: Sign error: accel returns -omega0^2 x + gamma v instead of - gamma v, so the code models negative damping; energy grows at exactly gamma, as expected for the wrong sign.

case04.flaw: Write-up says 0.86 vs 0.79 (+7 points); results.csv gives mean 0.811 vs 0.790, +2.1 points, so the pre-agreed 5-point criterion is not met.

case05.flaw: Best of 5 seeds (0.881) reported against a single baseline run; mean over seeds is 0.777, below the 0.781 baseline. Cherry-picked seed, no variance, baseline not run over seeds.

case06.flaw: Panel selected by correlation with response on all 60 patients (and standardised on all) before the train/test split: selection leakage. On pure noise this gives ~0.93; selection must happen inside each training split.

case07.flaw: line_flux.py integrates raw (line + background) instead of bgsub; the background-subtracted flux is 3.0, matching the model.
